reference_backend.role: correctness reference: Hugging Face model, one depth per pool, depth set through the instance attribute total_ut_steps

engine.requires: Python >= 3.10, torch >= 2.5; GPU inference needs Linux and an NVIDIA GPU
engine.status: installed on the pod on 2026-11-11 (editable, Python 3.12.3, torch 2.8.0+cu128); its own test suite: 916 passed, 633 skipped; driven unmodified, in process, through serving/looped/rlt_backend.py

measured_on_2026-11-11.prompt_depth: boundary_shift (withhold the last prompt token and let the engine emit it) and a depth-limited engine (total_ut_steps=r, stock prompt mode) both reproduce the reference exactly in fp32 at every depth; plain stock mode on the full engine differs from uniform depth only in the first generated token
measured_on_2026-11-11.kv: last_exited reserves every depth plane whatever the request depth; a depth-limited engine reserves r planes
measured_on_2026-11-11.bf16: tokens depend on batch composition, so equal seeds do not give equal candidates across runs

documented_behaviour_that_differs_from_t.reference: OuroRunner.forward(depth=r) runs r loops over the prompt and over every decoded token
documented_behaviour_that_differs_from_t.engine: prompt prefill always runs the model's full depth; SamplingParams.max_loops only limits later decode, and the first generated token comes from the full-depth prefill
documented_behaviour_that_differs_from_t.consequence: min_loops=max_loops=r is a different model from the saved depth-r candidates. Either add and test a per-request prefill depth, or redefine every baseline and regenerate the candidate pool under full-depth prefill.

documented_behaviour_that_differs_from_t.engine: LAST_EXITED copies the last computed depth into the skipped deeper planes; storage_depths = max_loops
documented_behaviour_that_differs_from_t.consequence: a branch fixed at depth r must never be deepened later, and running fewer loops may not reserve less KV memory. Both need measurement.

grader.evidence: regrading the 4,282 Stage-0b answers that have a boxed prediction with this version reproduces every stored mv_ok verdict; the version used on the pod was not recorded at the time
grader.note: string matching disagrees with it on 67 of those 4,282 answers, so a silent fallback is not acceptable
